## Goal
- Audit IVX IA deployment end-to-end, prevent stale release-proof reuse, publish the public-chat reliability fix, and provide truthful live production evidence.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do not use or request the legacy static owner token.
- Preserve Supabase JWT owner authorization; do not weaken direct-owner controls.
- Keep signed server-to-server worker authorization separate: HMAC, expiring single-use owner approval, exact action/SHA binding.
- Never print, commit, or expose secret values.
- Public-chat policy blocks must return renderable HTTP `200` turns; authorization failures remain `401`/`403`; use `409` only for genuine state conflicts.
- Do not claim production deployment or verification without live evidence.
- Keep unrelated `.rork/history/main/*.json` and `ios-ivx-holdings/` work out of the backend release.

## Progress
### Done
- Local signed-deployment authorization implementation is complete:
  - `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.ts` validates HMAC-SHA256 over worker ID, timestamp, nonce, method, path, and raw body.

- Local public-chat policy-block rendering fix is present:

  - `backend/services/ivx-public-chat-gate-response.ts` formats visible blocker responses.
  - Source confirms policy blocks are intentionally returned as normal completed turns at lines 390–405 of `backend/api/public-chat.ts`.
- Valid Supabase owner JWT previously authorized release job `ivx-worker-639a1564-5ea8-4f2c-8000-2997728b338a`:
  - Enqueue returned HTTP `202`.
  - Owner approval evidence: `ownerVerified:true`, `bearerAccepted:true`, `ownerEmailMatched:true`.
- The release job exposed and correctly invalidated a stale-proof defect:
  - Job reported `completed`, `finalStatus:"COMPLETE"`, `commitMatch:true`, and `healthOk:true`.
  - It reused old commit `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848` and old Render deployment `dep-d9hu14kfnr2s73anrtj0`.
  - Its `BUG_FIX` goal was classified/executed as `QA_ONLY`, with no changed files and no new commit.
- Render audit completed:
  - API service: `ivx-holdings-platform`, ID `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`, type `web_service`, branch `main`, auto-deploy enabled.
  - Render topology contains the production API web service and static sites; no separate `ivx-senior-dev-01` worker service exists.
  - Active live Render deployment: `dep-d9hu14kfnr2s73anrtj0`, status `live`, commit `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`.
  - Render environment inspection recorded variable names only, including `IVX_SENIOR_DEV_WORKER_ENABLED` and `GITHUB_TOKEN`; secret values were not exposed.

  - `resolveWorkerExecutionMode()` in `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` forces owner-approved production mutations to autonomous execution:
    - `approveGitDeploy:true` → `deploy`
    - `approvePatch:true` without deployment approval → `code_change`
    - Explicit `qa_only` cannot downgrade an approved mutation.
  - `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts` was added for execution-mode precedence and downgrade prevention.
  - `classifyTaskType()` in `backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.ts` now evaluates fix/repair/resolve/patch intent before feature keywords, preserving `CODE_FIX` for “fix plus regression test” requests.
  - Added regression coverage for `Fix the public chat response, deploy it, and verify the live endpoint`.
- Focused release-path validation now passes:
  - Command: `bun test backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.test.ts backend/services/ivx-public-chat-gate-response.test.ts backend/services/ivx-pre-execution-feasibility-gate.test.ts backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts`
  - Result: **96 passing checks**, including execution-mode routing, classifier behavior, public-chat gate rendering, feasibility gating, and signed deployment authorization.
  - `git diff --check` passed with no whitespace errors.
- Latest independent live audit evidence:
  - `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returned `{"ok":true,"status":"healthy","commit":"934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848","service":"ivx-owner-ai-backend"}`.
  - `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/version` returned `{"ok":true,"commit":"934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848","service":"ivx-owner-ai-backend"}`.
  - GitHub `main` remains `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`, message `release: publish validated IVX iOS source`.
  - Live `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat` with `{"message":"deploy now"}` remains HTTP `409`, body evidence includes `{"ok":false,"marker":"ivx-pre-execution-feasibility-gate-2026-07-05-v1"}`.
- `.rork/plans/force-sync-ivx-workspace-and-release-eve_1784928084433.plan.md` was updated with the Render audit, local corrective patch, passing focused validation, and failed live acceptance evidence.

### In Progress
- Inspect the complete `summarizeAutonomousCoderProof()` and terminal completion path in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` for an additional hard rejection of no-change/stale commit/deployment evidence on code-change jobs.
- Isolate, commit, and publish the required backend release files.
- Trigger a genuinely new Render deployment and collect commit/deployment/public-chat parity proof.
- Determine whether the in-process queue is the intended executor or whether the separately implemented dedicated worker must be provisioned.

### Blocked
- Production is not 100% verified for the reviewed fixes:
  - GitHub `main`, Render, `/health`, and `/version` remain at old SHA `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`.
  - Production `POST /api/public/chat` still returns HTTP `409` rather than the locally implemented HTTP `200` renderable gate response.
  - Therefore no new live deployment, public-chat fix, or stale-proof correction can truthfully be claimed as released.
- No Render service named `ivx-senior-dev-01` exists despite `backend/workers/ivx-senior-dev-worker-entry.ts` defining a dedicated worker entry point.
- Full repository typecheck remains blocked by unrelated existing errors:
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(82,39): error TS2339: Property 'totalDistributions' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(114,23): error TS2339: Property 'id' does not exist on type 'LedgerEntry'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts(7712,9): error TS2322: Type '"ivx_qa_only_runtime"' is not assignable...`
  - `backend/hono.ts(5059,28): error TS2554: Expected 2 arguments, but got 1.`

## Key Decisions
- Reject any release result that reuses an existing commit/deployment when the request required a code change.
- Do not treat health checks and SHA parity alone as proof of a patch release; require newly committed changed-file evidence, corresponding Render deployment, production health/version parity, and live endpoint acceptance.
- Force execution mode from approved mutation flags at the owner API boundary:
  - `approveGitDeploy:true` → `deploy`
  - `approvePatch:true` without deploy approval → `code_change`
  - Explicit `qa_only` cannot downgrade an owner-approved production mutation.
- Classify explicit fix intent as `CODE_FIX` before feature signals such as adding regression tests.
- Keep direct human owner actions guarded by Supabase owner JWT; HMAC remains internal-worker-only.
- Record the current HTTP `409` result as failed live evidence, not as deployment proof.

## Next Steps
1. Finish review of `summarizeAutonomousCoderProof()` and terminal guards; add a focused regression that rejects reused `commitSha`/`deployId` evidence for code-changing jobs.
2. Review `git diff` and commit only:
   - `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`
   - `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts`
   - `backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.ts`
   - `backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.test.ts`
   - Any directly required release ledger entry.
3. Push the reviewed commit to `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` `main`.
4. Poll Render service `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0` until a new deployment is `live` on the new GitHub SHA.
5. Verify GitHub SHA, Render deployment ID/commit, `/health`, and `/version` all report the new SHA.
6. Probe `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat` with `{"message":"deploy now"}`; require HTTP `200`, `ok:true`, and a non-empty visible `answer`.
7. Record the new SHA, deployment ID, test results, health/version output, and public-chat result in `.rork/plans/force-sync-ivx-workspace-and-release-eve_1784928084433.plan.md`.
8. Provision or identify the actual autonomous worker hosting path and configure matching private `IVX_INTERNAL_DEPLOY_SECRET` / `IVX_INTERNAL_WORKER_ID` only if the dedicated worker implementation is required.
